name: WARNING: Authentic Salsa Verde (Raw Acidic Tomatillos, Serrano Chiles & Raw Onion)
whyItWorks: Green tomatillos have exceptionally high natural malic and citric acid content. Blended raw with fiery green serrano peppers, whole seeds, and raw white onions, it aggressively burns eroded mucosal ulcers.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Keep green and red salsas completely off your tacos. Season solely with fresh lime juice and sea salt.
